Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on model fit and guardrails:

Immediate actions we suggest:
1) I’ll share an evidence pack (benchmarks CSV + sample outputs + prompt set).
2) Engineering sync: connect your eng team with our runtime leads to review prefix caching and safety knobs (I’ve CC’d a contact).
3) Provisional pin: we can provisionally pin a snapshot for your production traffic while we run extended golden-set evals.
4) Emergency freeze protocol: if you detect a quality regression after a downstream model update, we have a documented freeze + rollback runbook we can put in place for ClearPay.

Attachments I’ll upload now: benchmarks_clearpay_q4.csv, prompt_set_clearpay_v1.jsonl.

Proposed timeline: evidence pack (today), eng sync (this week), provisional pin + 7-day canary (next week).

If that sounds good I’ll schedule the eng call and share the Drive folder with the detailed evals.

Kim / Marissa —

Quick internal note before we reply to Rajiv with the ask he made.

Context: Ops observed a subtle quality regression last month after a backend model variant rollout where sampling-temperature defaults changed in the orchestration layer; the regression surfaced only on a small group of billing-dispute prompts (seeded golden-set). We shipped a fix and then added a snapshot/pinning option for affected customers.

Proposed external response (high level):
- Yes, we support customer-level pinning. We can pin to a specific model artifact (example: rw-medium-v2-q4f16@20261110) for an initial 90-day window while we run the expanded golden-set.
- Offer: complimentary 30-day pin at pilot start, then option to extend (billing/ops to finalize).
- Freeze protocol: open FreezeTicket-RED-312 (internal runbook link) which:
  * captures triage steps,
  * triggers an automatic rollback to pinned artifact if regression crosses threshold,
  * notifies customer and SRE on-call.

Action items for reply:
1) Attach regression_diff_report.pdf (redacted) and rollback-playbook.md (ops runbook).
2) Provide a token-level metrics CSV (benchmarks_clearpay_q4.csv) and the prompt_set_clearpay_v1.jsonl.
3) Ask if they want the pin to be enforced on all traffic or just production canary. Recommend canary by default.

LMK — I’ll pull the final redacted diff and the suggested pin identifier.
